terms.comment: Our formation from Ōceanus, on the model of aquārium (see aquarium), kept as the Latin name of the Oceanarium in Lisbon. For a public aquarium in general Andresian has piscīna zōologica (p. 43); Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word.
terms.gloss: the Latin form of the name of the Oceanarium in Lisbon

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
